During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a small '''security force''' was maintained by the Galactic Republic on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to protect the local [[Jedi Enclave]]. Among its forces was a squadron of [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]].
